product.title: 2 to 6 hours Private Yacht Cruise around Fort Lauderdale

description.text: This private tour makes discovering Fort Lauderdale’s Intracoastal Waterway effortless. The route highlights waterfront estates, open Atlantic access, and the yacht-lined channels that define greater Fort Lauderdale. Equipment, safety briefings, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on Fort Lauderdale's waterways and coastal wildlife. Ideal for groups on Fort Lauderdale's Intracoastal Waterway who want a private captain without handling marina logistics.
